title: Enforce 2-page PDF budget with auto-fit harness
body:
Adds a hard guarantee that the generated PDFs never exceed 2 pages, even as content grows.

- `gen-pdf.mjs` auto-fits (shrinks print scale to an 85% readable floor) and fails if it still overflows.
- New required CI check **PDF page budget** runs on every PR, so overflow is blocked before merge — not discovered after deploy.
- Deterministic page counting via `pdf-lib`. Documented in `AGENTS.md`.

Validated locally: auto-fit shrinks to fit; floor-overflow exits non-zero with an actionable message.
